inclusions.source: The day runs in a private vehicle, which means the pace adjusts to your interest at each site rather than being governed by a group.

inclusions.text: Guide and driver collect you from your Cairo hotel
inclusions.source: The morning begins early — your guide and driver collect you from your Cairo hotel, and you are on the highway before the city's traffic fully asserts itself.

inclusions.text: Transported back to their hotel in Cairo
inclusions.source: By the end of the tour, guests will be transported back to their hotel in Cairo, concluding a day filled with historical exploration and cultural discovery.
